update.releaseNotes:
v1.8.0 - Daily Legend Race, rewards after the last career, new outfits
- New: Daily Legend Race in Settings, off by default. After Daily Races or Team Trials it races your free daily Legend ticket once and never buys a ticket. - Changed: Rewards and Club also run after the last career of a run, and a run queue started on the Club screen no longer stops. The Club item request reads Winner's Sash counts more reliably. - Added: Hokko Tarumae, three newly released outfits with presets, six support cards and updated skill rankings.
